name: Raheja Imperia
address: Shankar Rao Naram Path, near Peninsula Corporate Park, Lower Parel (marketed as Worli), Mumbai 400013
amenities: Squash, tennis, badminton, basketball and volleyball courts
description: A high-rise luxury residential development by Raheja Universal on Shankar Rao Naram Path, next to Peninsula Corporate Park, in Lower Parel, which portals market as Worli. MahaRERA registered phase Imperia-I in 2017 with a completion date of Dec 2022. Wikipedia's list of Mumbai's tallest buildings gives a 214 m, 52-floor tower completed in 2022. It offers compact-carpet 3 and 4 BHK homes (about 1,400-1,950 sq ft carpet) and larger 5 BHK units, with registered resales averaging about Rs 75,750/sq ft in 2025-26.
notes: Sourcing is still mostly portals. The launch date is unknown: broker listings were already offering primary "New Booking" units in Aug-Sep 2014 at about Rs 30,000/sq ft (built-up), with possession promised for Dec 2018-Dec 2019. MahaRERA's original commencement of 22 Aug 2017 is the registration of the ongoing phase, not necessarily the launch. Possession conflict: Square Yards shows 'Ready to Move since Dec 2019' but its FAQ gives Dec 2022 and calls construction 'mid-stage'. Wikipedia lists completion in 2022, and no OC date was found. Towers and floors: MahaRERA phase P51900009379 (Raheja Imperia-I) covers one tower, but registrations reference towers / wings 1, 2, A and B. Floors are 52 (Wikipedia), 54 (RealEstateMumbai), and a registered unit on floor 58 (Square Yards), so towers and floors_max are left out. Units: 459 total, with 262 launched units fully booked by Nov 2025 (Square Yards); the gap suggests more phases or rehab / landowner units. Do not confuse with Raheja Imperia II (The Rivière), a separate current Raheja Universal project in Worli, or with K Raheja Corp, an unrelated company. Computed gross yield: a 3 BHK of 1,447 sq ft carpet asking Rs 3.9 lakh/month, at the registered average of Rs 75,750/sq ft (about Rs 10.96 crore), is about 4.3%. A 4 BHK of 1,950 sq ft at Rs 7.5 lakh/month is about 6.1%. These use asking rents and look high for Worli/Lower Parel. ADDED (Nov 2026 top-up): CTBUH lists Raheja Imperia I as 214 m, 52 floors above ground, 263 apartments, proposed 2008, construction start 2014, completed 2022, architect J.P. Parekh And Sons, structural engineer Mahimtura Consultants. MGS Architecture (undated) gives 225.3 m / 60 storeys, KONE 4 m/s lifts (4 passenger and 1 service lift per wing, plus 2 clubhouse lifts) and a 60th-level infinity pool; Dwello (Aug 2018) lists floors 11-58 as residential, 59 as a service floor and 60 as the amenity level. These floor counts may number levels differently, so floors_max stays out. Land: the developer's Feb 2017 release calls it a low-density project on a virgin plot with no SRA, rehab or public-parking obligation (land_type private); 'freehold' comes only from 2014 broker listings. Loading: Square Yards (Jun 2021) shows a 4 BHK of 1,930 sq ft carpet as 3,003 sq ft saleable, about 56% loading, which matches the 3,003-3,004 sq ft built-up 4 BHKs in 2014 listings. Metro: Propscience gives Acharya Atre Chowk Metro at 0.82 km. transactions_12m (15) is the Square Yards count for Nov 2025-Oct 2026. GAPS: no registered deal in the news, no OC date, no maintenance figure.

news.title: Raheja Imperia Sets Benchmark for Low Density Luxury Housing in India
news.summary: Raheja Universal promotes Imperia in Worli as low-density 3-5 BHK homes on a virgin plot free of SRA, rehab or public-parking obligations, with 30 amenities across four zones and a top-floor infinity pool.

news.title: Property Review of Raheja Imperia in Lower Parel, Mumbai
news.summary: Review of the MahaRERA-registered project, then promising possession in Dec 2021, with 3, 4, 4.5 and 5 BHK homes; floors 46-58 are skyplexes and floor 60 holds the infinity pool and sky lounge.

news.title: Xanadu Introduces a Luxury Vertical in Worli, South Mumbai, Starting With Raheja Imperia 2
news.summary: Xanadu Realty starts a luxury sales vertical with about Rs 2,000 crore of Worli inventory, beginning with the sister phase Raheja Imperia II (The Riviere). This concerns the next phase, not Imperia I.
